fields.title: Tashkent- Russian-Speaking Teacher/Governess
fields.description:
A VIP family in Tashkent, Uzbekistan is seeking an intelligent, highly educated, and culturally refined Russian-speaking Nanny/Governess to support the holistic development of their 5-year-old son.

This role is ideal for a warm, articulate, and intellectually curious professional who is passionate about children’s education, culture, and personal growth.

About the Role

This is not a traditional academic tutoring position.

The child already has a team of nannies managing daily care and multilingual exposure.

Your role will focus on intellectual, emotional, and cultural enrichment, helping the boy develop a love for reading, creativity, and the arts.

The family seeks a native (or near-native) Russian speaker with conversational English who can inspire curiosity, expand the child’s cultural horizons, and gently guide his manners and social development.

Key Responsibilities

• Support the child’s holistic development through cultural, educational, and creative activities.

• Introduce poems, stories, and early Russian literature; foster appreciation for theatre, music, and the arts.

• Encourage reading habits and nurture imagination through intellectual play.

• Promote emotional intelligence, kindness, and age-appropriate manners.

• Collaborate closely with existing nannies to maintain a smooth, balanced daily routine.

• Create a positive, joyful, and engaging learning environment.

Requirements

• Native Russian speaker (or near-native fluency).

• University degree required — ideally in Early Childhood Education, or Teaching.

• 10+ years of professional experience as a tutor/governess, preferably within VIP or private households.

• Strong understanding of child development and creative learning methods.

• Cultured, well-read, articulate, and passionate about literature, theatre, music, and art.

• Intelligent, warm, emotionally stable, and excellent with children.

• Energetic, active, adaptable, and enthusiastic about child development.

• Conversational English for communication and travel.

• EU passport preferred (not essential).

• Experience in international households is a strong advantage.

Working Conditions

• Full-time or rota position (to be discussed).

• 5 days per week with flexibility.

• Live-in accommodation provided.

• Occasional travel with the family may be required.

• Start date: As soon as possible.

Salary

£1,200–£1,500 per week, depending on experience and qualifications.

fields.title: Technical Sales Manager – Bermuda (Relocation Opportunity)
fields.description:
Dreaming of blue skies, crystal waters, and a tax-free island lifestyle? Our client in Bermuda is seeking a Technical Sales Manager to drive growth in the building and construction sector. Combine your technical sales expertise with a unique career adventure abroad!

What’s on offer:
• Competitive package: £40-50k base + commission (~USD $75-100k, tax-free)
• Career development and professional growth
• Exciting work in Bermuda’s vibrant construction industry

You’ll be responsible for:
• Achieving sales targets and securing product specifications
• Engaging clients, architects, and contractors through demos, presentations, and events
• Managing quotes, orders, and project tracking from concept to completion
• Maintaining ERP/QuickBooks systems, POS, and reporting
• Attending trade shows and monitoring market trends

We’re looking for someone with:
• Proven technical sales experience in building products
• Construction/building knowledge and ability to read drawings
• Proficiency in QuickBooks/ERP systems
• Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills
• Bachelor’s degree in Sales, Construction, Engineering, Architecture, or equivalent experience

fields.title: Construction Superintendent (Relocation Opportunity)
fields.description:

 2–3 year contract | Full-time

fields.title: House Manager – VVIP Family, Tashkent.
fields.description:
Start Date: ASAP or 25th September

A highly prestigious VVIP household in Tashkent is seeking an experienced House Manager to oversee and lead the daily running of a large, fully staffed private residence. This is a demanding but rewarding role for a candidate with proven experience managing high-level households and the ability to lead with authority, discretion, and professionalism.

Key Responsibilities:

Oversee the smooth running of a large private residence.
Manage and coordinate a team of household staff, ensuring the highest standards are maintained.
Handle all daily operations, logistics, and scheduling within the household.
Ensure seamless service delivery to principals and guests.
Uphold strict confidentiality and professionalism at all times.
Requirements:

Fluent in English and Russian is mandatory.
Extensive experience as a House Manager in VIP or VVIP households.
Strong leadership and staff management skills.
Highly organised, adaptable, and able to work under pressure.
Flexible approach to hours – must be available for longer or shorter days as needed.
A hardworking, professional, and discreet attitude.
Package & Benefits:

Salary: £7,000 per month.
Accommodation: Provided separately.
Flights, meals, and drinks covered whilst at work.
Full-time schedule: 5 days per week, 10 hours per day (flexibility required).
This is a key leadership role within a highly important household and requires dedication, energy, and discretion. The right candidate will be rewarded with a highly competitive package and the opportunity to work in a prestigious environment.

How to Apply:

Please submit your CV and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and availability
